en: The image shows a vintage postcard bordered with the colors of the Italian flag (red, white, and green). The central image is a black-and-white panoramic photograph of a town at the foot of a mountain. There is a visible church with a bell tower in the middle of the town. In the top right of the image, the text 'ALA - Panorama' identifies the location. At the bottom right, there is an Italian poem or quote printed in italic script.
